products.name: AUCR DPI–Inclusion Benchmark
products.scope: A reproducible benchmark framework for examining how Indian states and union territories convert digital-public-infrastructure and financial-access conditions into use, capability and resilience outcomes.
products.unitOfAnalysis: Indian state or union territory as represented in the deposited dataset release
products.claimBoundary: The benchmark may describe results generated from the deposited data and disclosed method. It must not certify institutional quality, establish causality, demonstrate that a policy caused observed outcomes, determine eligibility or predict future performance, and it must not publish a ranking until the exact release inputs and transformation pipeline have been independently reproduced.
products.privacy: Uses only aggregate, deposited research data. It accepts no private institutional, respondent-level or client research data.
products.nextReleaseGate: Reproduce the deposited release from its codebook and pipeline, reconcile every output against the DOI record, and publish a versioned result table with limitations before adding comparative scores to the public page.
